Shaped iteration 0112 as one bounded benchmark task: integrate reviewed WP1 project-text preparation into the existing writing method.
[Iteration 0111](history/records/0111.json) accepted #551's exact review preservation; [provenance](../benchmark/project-text-writing-0109/review-0110-provenance.md) permits scoped integration with a new addendum and later independent review.
The [task graph](tasks.json) assigns benchmark/default/high, 120 minutes and 80 turns, with no dependencies.
It permits five existing writing-method files and two new integration provenance files; the project original and historical evidence remain pinned.
The existing verifier fixes four tasks and synthetic controls, so the task explicitly extends those interfaces for a separate public project-text stratum.
WP1 preserves the exact requested text delta while keeping native save-version authority, independent keys and full-trial eligibility unresolved.
Verification is one offline command: `python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py`; new controls and provenance checks must join that command.
Read the graph back and checked its JSON structure, permitted role/options, required sections, limits and empty dependency set; no shell execution was available to this shaper.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) with completed preservation, the integration scope and cold-session review instructions.
No LabVIEW session, trial, readiness promotion or product implementation is ordered; #532 remains pending without blocking ready work.

## What next
After integration, pin its actual baseline/candidate tree and independently review the changed method against the preserved proposal/review and original evidence. Resume saved work if checks fail; avoid replaying historical review probes or refreshing frozen checker hashes.
